model_provenance.candidate_artifact_limitation: External quantized weights/calibration artifacts are not discovered automatically; supply their separate manifest before claiming full candidate reproducibility.

policy: Fresh logical KV reset before every request; canonical B8 prefill, separate FP32 scalar decode/head; no cache reuse or suffix. Candidate uses fused FP32 prefill with12 workers and8 decode; reference is deployed fused FP32 prefill with12/8; candidate shares paired-query value loads while preserving each output reduction order. Two separately linked resident models. No placement guarantees.
limitations: Two resident models, alternating warmed requests; no OS cache eviction or hard isolation. Direct closed dumps preserve pools. Both profiles must have identical full logit bits; each profile must reproduce its own full logit bits and both profiles must produce identical fixed-count greedy IDs. Separate real quality/replay/suffix gates required.

warm_full_logits.interpretation: Same-profile full-vocabulary bit equality and matching greedy IDs are required; no tolerance gate.
